properties.comment: This report delivers the calculated usage for each constraint for each 5 minute trading interval

fields.doc: Date and time of the trading interval (DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS) fixed to the UTC+10 time zone (NEM time)
fields.name: INTERVAL_DATETIME

fields.doc: Constraint ID (binding constraint ID from FCAS data used in FPP calculations)
fields.name: CONSTRAINTID

fields.doc: Version (FPP run number from the FPP database)
fields.name: VERSIONNO

fields.doc: Bid type (the bid type saved in relation to constraint ID from FCAS data used in FPP calculations)
fields.name: BIDTYPE

fields.doc: Enabled regulation MW used in the FPP calculation (from FPP database)
fields.name: REGULATION_MW

fields.doc: Maximum used regulation MW value (quantity of regulation FCAS that was calculated to be used in MW)
fields.name: USED_MW

fields.doc: Usage (calculation of the proportion of regulation FCAS that was calculated to be used)
fields.name: USAGE

fields.doc: The reason flag showing the decision matrix for the usage calculation Supported values are: 0 = Usage is calculated based on good input data 1 = Usage is 0 as FM is unreliable 2 = Usage is 0 as the percentage of units with unavailable input or bad data is greater than the threshold percentage
fields.name: USAGE_REASON_FLAG
